authority_scope: existing server-owned conversation thread and immutable message ledger

apis.recover: GET /api/v1/conversations/{thread_id}/recovery returns the current canonical snapshot and committed pending user turn identity; execution status remains owned by existing chat turn endpoints
apis.regeneration: Existing POST /messages/{assistant_id}/regenerate supports exact provider/model/output settings and deferred acceptance; sibling GET /regenerate/turn, POST /regenerate/resume and POST /regenerate/cancel expose actual engine status, exact stored-command recovery and cancellation
apis.export: GET /api/v1/conversations/{thread_id}/export?format=json|markdown&expected_thread_version=<optional current version> returns server-rendered canonical active transcript under exact thread owner/tenant and current governed export rights

rules: every read and mutation filters authenticated tenant and owner before returning conversation content
search is bounded case-insensitive literal title matching, never caller supplied regular expression
opaque list cursor only selects an ordering position and confers no authorization
rename and archive/reopen use the current thread version; deleting/deleted threads cannot be renamed or reopened
pending chat turns are reconstructed from committed user messages and canonical assistant or system-derived terminal markers, never browser transcript state
snapshot paging follows immutable active parent lineage, rejects missing/cyclic/foreign/ahead-of-commit messages and reports an explicit continuation cursor
snapshot checks its thread version after reading and returns conflict if it cannot provide a coherent current projection
retry preserves the existing user message idempotency key and exact causal identity; no new conversation store or provider path is introduced

edited messages retain original source attachment references but discard obsolete prior execution identity references; the current committed edited USER tip may bind an exact hashed request once in operational metadata on its existing message row
operational request binding preserves immutable message content and lineage, rejects differing retry semantics, and is checked against the current authorized active tip/thread version before dispatch

the exact bounded compiled chat engine command is persisted write-once on the existing committed USER row before engine submission, preserving ephemeral context, model settings and memory policy across pre-admission restart without trusting browser reconstruction

regeneration freezes the exact server-compiled command and selection once on the existing original assistant row before engine admission; retries reuse that record and terminal output creates an immutable sibling branch only while the original thread sequence/branch fence remains current

regeneration dispatch uses bounded operational ready/submitting/admitted/withdrawn CAS metadata on the same row; ready requests can be durably withdrawn before dispatch, while already-claimed submissions retain cancellation intent until actual engine terminal truth is known

export includes only authorized canonical active-lineage messages and their provenance/branch references, requires active exportable unexpired governance records for that exact thread and every included message, and excludes raw attachment payloads and other tenants or owners
metadata writes retain existing storage admission and deletion retains existing governance propagation
verification: Implementation and static review only in this work window; user explicitly instructed no test creation or execution. No fresh runtime validation or closure evidence is claimed.
rollback: Withdraw additive search/metadata/snapshot routes while retaining all existing canonical threads, immutable messages, versions and governed deletion state.
